newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks further adrift in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks further adrift in dull trade.

text.p: Mexican stocks drifted down further in early afternoon trade on Friday on what traders said was market apathy.
"It's completely dull; what little selling there is is hitting prices. Only a few are picking up paper and they are doing so at very low prices," a floor trader said.
The leading IPC share index was down 17.3 points, or 0.46 percent, at 3,739.31.
Volume was slack at just 24.2 million shares traded.
Dealers said trade was slow as many in Mexico had taken a long weekend's vacation to straddle two public holidays, between Thursday, May 1, and Monday May 5.
